about: What our first real runs on Modal taught us (2026-10-08). Source: .reference/STATUS.md 'Verified' (the first real Claude Code agent run of small-calc on Modal through Harbor) and the owner's notes. These are the dusk observations the capability story starts from: the agent recognises from them that it lacks a calculation environment and creates a pinned calc image.

run.where: Modal via Harbor 0.24 (local test), Claude Code agent
run.result: Na+-water binding, PySCF B3LYP/def2-TZVP with counterpoise: -25.5 kcal/mol at 2.2 Å; reward 1; 34 trace events

observations.what: first agent image build on Modal before the agent could start
observations.lesson: Build the agent image once, push it to a registry and point AGENT_RUNNER_MODAL_IMAGE (or the task's calc_image) at it; Modal caches a pulled image, a Dockerfile build costs ~170 s.

observations.what: the agent pip-installed PySCF itself, on every run
observations.lesson: PySCF, numpy and matplotlib belong in the image (pinned, in /opt/calc): reinstalling them costs ~1 min per run (130 s for the full pinned stack).

observations.what: a 4-minute sleep while waiting for the calculation
observations.lesson: Never sleep-wait for a calculation (a 240 s sleep in the first Modal run): start it in the background, poll its log every 10-15 s, and write the manuscript meanwhile.

observations.what: python3 -m venv failed: 'ensurepip is not available' (Harbor 0.24 runs agent steps on bare ubuntu without python3-venv)
observations.lesson: On a bare ubuntu sandbox, `python3 -m venv` fails with 'ensurepip is not available': run `apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv` first, or use the calc image where /opt/calc exists.

observations.what: PySCF/numpy start one OpenMP thread per host core; on a busy shared host a 1 s HF smoke test took 10.8 s (1.4 s with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1)
observations.lesson: Set OMP_NUM_THREADS to the sandbox's allotted cores (1-2 on a small Modal box) before running PySCF: per-host-core threads oversubscribe and slow small calculations 5-8x.

gap.name: calc-image
gap.why: every small-calc run rebuilt its calculation environment: ~60 s PySCF install (130 s for the pinned stack), a venv failure (ensurepip), on top of a 170 s image build
gap.line: CAPABILITY_GAP: calc-image: PySCF/numpy/matplotlib are not preinstalled; venv repair + pip install cost 60-130 s per run

setup_s.dusk_note: 170 s image build + ~60 s PySCF install (the 240 s sleep is waste, fixed by the protocol, not by a capability)
